---
title: "Configuration"
---

The global file `~/.config/onthesignal/config.toml` is overridden by `onthesignal.toml` in the
working directory. `/config` shows the merged configuration and the files read;
`/config section.key=value` changes a value for the session.

```toml
[analysis]          # defaults of the analysis parameters with the same name
fmax = 100.0
mains_freq = 50.0
full_scale = 16777216      # 2**24

[console]
editor = "nano"            # or "vi"
mpl_backend = "QtAgg"      # matplotlib backend (TkAgg by default)
history_file = "~/.local/state/onthesignal/history"

[seedlink]
server = "10.16.0.163"
port = 18000
network = "RD"
station = "SN270"
reconnect_attempts = 5
reconnect_delay = 5.0

[ai]
provider = "ollama"        # "anthropic", "openai" or "ollama"
model = "<model name>"
base_url = ""
context = 0                # Ollama context in tokens (0 = server default)
auto_execute = "read_only"
send_raw_data = false

[report]
pdf_engine = "typst"       # or "latex"
author = ""

[paths]
scripts = "scripts"
reports = "reports"
state = ".onthesignal"

[web]                      # web interface (onthesignal web)
host = "127.0.0.1"         # listen address; another address exposes the server (no login)
port = 8080
open_browser = true
allowed_hosts = []         # extra host names accepted in the Host header
code_execution = true      # false: no Python terminal, script or AI code execution
scrollback = 10000         # lines kept in the Python terminal
roots = ["."]              # folders reachable from the explorer, the editor and the batches
                           # (relative to the project, or absolute: [".", "/data/bench"])
upload_dir = "data/uploads"
upload_max_mb = 1024
editor_max_mb = 5
tls_cert = ""              # certificate and key for HTTPS
tls_key = ""
```

Parameter precedence: value given in the call > signal attribute (`S.full_scale`) >
`[analysis]` section > built-in default.
